ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, circle O is the circumcircle of right $\triangle ABC$, with $\angle ACB=90^\circ$ and $\angle A=25^\circ$. A tangent to circle O passes through point C and intersects the extension of AB at point D. What is the measure of $\angle D$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect OC, \\
$\because$ Circle O is the circumcircle of the Rt$\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACB=90^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ AB is the diameter, \\
$\because$ $\angle A=25^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle BOC=2\angle A=50^\circ$, \\
$\because$ CD is a tangent to circle O, \\
$\therefore$ OC$\perp$CD, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle D=90^\circ-\angle BOC=\boxed{40^\circ}$.
